# OptimisedWebsite

> OptimisedWebsite is a UK web studio that builds SEO-optimised websites: sites engineered from first principles for organic search visibility, where keyword research and topical mapping precede the build and every page ships entity-linked JSON-LD schema and perfect Core Web Vitals.

## Summary
OptimisedWebsite (https://optimisedwebsite.com) designs and builds SEO-optimised Astro 5 websites for UK businesses. Each build is 15 to 50 pages, structured around hub-and-spoke content architecture, with entity-interconnected JSON-LD schema (7 to 12 schema types per site) and static HTML for sub-second loads. Fixed price 1,500 to 3,000 GBP. Delivery in 5 to 7 days. Founded and run by Sunny Patel, an SEO consultant based in Reading, UK.

## Canonical definitions
- SEO-optimised website: A website engineered from first principles for organic search visibility. Keyword research, topical mapping, internal-linking architecture, and schema planning happen before any HTML is written. Every page carries entity-linked JSON-LD schema within a site-wide @graph, and the site is delivered as static HTML for perfect Core Web Vitals. This is distinct from a conventional website that retrofits SEO (meta tags, alt text, heading fixes) after design is complete. Related concepts: Search engine optimization (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Search_engine_optimization), Web design (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_design).
- Topical authority: The depth and breadth of content a site has on a subject. OptimisedWebsite builds it in from day one via hub-and-spoke linking rather than retrofitting it.
- Hub-and-spoke architecture: A content pattern where a central hub page links to related spoke pages, consolidating topical authority and distributing internal link equity.

## Key facts and stats
- Founder: Sunny Patel, SEO Consultant, Reading, UK
- Sites built and ranked: 44+ across health, automotive, home services, developer tools, food, and SaaS verticals
- Lighthouse score: 100/100 on every site delivered
- Delivery time: 5 to 7 days
- Price: 1,500 to 3,000 GBP, fixed (no recurring platform fee)
- Tech stack: Astro 5, Tailwind CSS, deployed to Cloudflare Pages edge network
- Schema types per site: 7 to 12 (Organization, WebSite, Service, Article, FAQPage, HowTo, BreadcrumbList and more)
- Page count per build: 15 to 50
- Ownership: client owns the GitHub repository, domain, hosting account, and content; no proprietary CMS, no vendor lock-in

## Services
- SEO Website Build: Complete Astro 5 site with hub-and-spoke architecture
- Keyword Research: Niche analysis, keyword clustering, topical mapping
- Schema Markup: Entity-interconnected JSON-LD (7 to 12 types per site)
- Technical SEO: Sitemap, robots.txt, canonicals, Core Web Vitals
- Content Architecture: Internal linking strategy, heading hierarchy
